_note: Single seed source for the demo. Consumed by app/store.mjs (in-memory on Vercel) and demo/deploy_demo.mjs (writes the local JSON files). 'mei' is a pre-existing passport so Lender view / My-passport have something to show, and its nullifier 'seed-mei' backs the 'second passport, same human' rejection. aiko/kenji are deliberately NOT seeded so the borrower can mint them live.
